layouts.main_container: flex h-screen overflow-hidden bg-background text-foreground transition-colors duration-300
layouts.sidebar: w-64 border-r border-border/40 bg-surface/50 backdrop-blur-xl hidden md:flex flex-col
layouts.header: sticky top-0 z-50 flex h-16 items-center justify-between px-6 border-b border-border/40 bg-surface/80 backdrop-blur-md
layouts.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6

cards.kpi: col-span-1 md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-3 flex flex-col p-6 rounded-xl border border-border/50 bg-surface shadow-sm transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md
cards.chart: col-span-1 md:col-span-4 lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col p-6 rounded-xl border border-border/50 bg-surface shadow-sm
cards.heatmap_full: col-span-1 md:col-span-4 lg:col-span-12 flex flex-col p-6 rounded-xl border border-border/50 bg-surface shadow-sm overflow-x-auto

components.navigation: Sidebar with NavLinks. Active state uses solid primary color border on left, slightly tinted background. Keep it dense and professional.
components.kpi_card: Include large number, delta indicator (green/red arrow), and minimal sparkline (recharts) at the bottom. Use solid bold typography for values.
components.mitre_heatmap: Table/Grid layout. Tactics as columns, Techniques as cells. Color code cells based on detection coverage or threat frequency. Use gradient or distinct severity colors (e.g., Gray for none, Blue/Red intensity for hits). Implement hover states to reveal sub-techniques.
components.data_table: Shadcn Table with sortable headers, sticky headers, and pagination. Apply dense padding for operational data.
components.time_tabs: Shadcn Tabs (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly). Make them pill-shaped or segmented controls with clear active states.
components.theme_toggle: Sun/Moon icon button in the header. Persist in localStorage.
components.upload_zone: Drag-and-drop zone with dashed border, icon, and 'Select File' button for CSV/Excel ingestion. Add subtle hover effect.
components.ai_recommendations: A prominent panel on the Executive overview highlighting text insights with a subtle gradient or glowing border (The Tracing Beam concept sparingly).

charts_libraries.recommendation: Recharts for standard Line/Bar/Area/Pie. Visx or custom CSS Grid for MITRE Heatmap. RadialBarChart for composite/health scores.
charts_libraries.guidelines: Remove grid lines or make them very subtle (opacity 0.1). Hide axes lines. Use custom tooltips with dark background and clear typography. Avoid generic colors; use the palette provided.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use on sticky headers and dropdowns: backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 border-border/40
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Not recommended for this data-dense app.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle borders on cards: border border-border/50. Hover states should slightly increase border opacity/color.
visual_enhancers.animations: Framer Motion for page transitions (fade + slide up 10px). Animate KPI numbers counting up.

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }}

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Provide high contrast mode.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon buttons. role='tablist' for tabs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install necessary libraries: lucide-react, recharts, clsx, tailwind-merge, framer-motion, @radix-ui/react-tabs, @radix-ui/react-dialog, @radix-ui/react-slot, sonner.
Setup routing with dummy JWT auth (store in state/localStorage) to toggle personas: soc_manager, client, detection_engineer, ti_analyst, automation_engineer. Provide a login screen to select persona.
Build the Sidebar Navigation that dynamically shows links based on the active persona role, but keep all 6 dashboards accessible for demo purposes.
Create a reusable Layout component containing Sidebar and Header (with user profile, role selector, theme toggle).
Develop the Landing Page (Cross-Functional Executive Overview) with overall SOC Health Score, Risk Score, Incident Volume, MTTR, AI Recommendations.
Implement the 5 Persona Dashboards: SOC Manager, Client Executive, Detection Engineering, Threat Intelligence, SOAR/Automation.
Each dashboard MUST include the Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly tabs controlling the data views.
For the MITRE Heatmap, create a reusable component mapping tactics to columns and techniques to cells, colored by risk/coverage.
Include an 'Upload Data' button in the Header or pages that opens a Modal with a drag-and-drop CSV/Excel file upload UI.
Ensure the theme can be toggled and persists (Dark/Light). Map Tailwind dark variant to a class on the html/body.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements like buttons, tabs, inputs, and major sections.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs/headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use generous spacing (2-3x more than usual) to avoid cramped designs.
Prioritize Shadcn UI patterns and override defaults as needed to match the brand.
Never use placeholder text for images. Use the provided image URLs.
